<entry id="H00133">
<head-word>חָג</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> חגג; cmp. מוֹעֵד</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> אֵיד)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>anniversary, festival</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 29; Pesik. Baḥod. p. 153
<sup>a</sup> ויש לו חג וחַגּוֹ בן יומו a New-Moon of a month in which there is a festival and whose festival coincides with the New-Moon, v. כָּסָה I. Y. Taan. IV, 69
<sup>b</sup> bot., v. דְּרוֹמָאָה. Sot. 36
<sup>b</sup> יום חַגָּם their (the Egyptians’) festive day; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ag</italic> (
<italic>festive period</italic>), 
<italic>the Feast of Booths with its Eighth Day of Convocation</italic> (שמיני עצרת). Succ. IV, 2 י"ט הראשון של חג the first Holy Day of the 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ag</italic>; ib. 5 י"ט האחרון וכ' the last &c. (the eighth day); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>pilgrim’s festive offering</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥag. 10
<sup>b</sup>, v. next w., a. חֲגִיגָה.—
<plural-form>Pl. חַגִּים,</plural-form> constr. חַגֵּי. Ber. 33
<sup>b</sup> ח' נדבה periods of free-will offerings.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00134">
<head-word>חַגָּא, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Deut. XVI, 16.—Targ. Y. Gen. XVIII, 14 זמן ח' (h. text מועד); a. fr.—Ḥag. 10
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ex. XII, 14) how can you prove that this 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ag</italic> means (festive) offering, דילמא חוגו חגא וכ' perhaps it means ‘celebrate a feast’?—Ib. דילמא … אכלו … וחוגו ח' וכ' perhaps the text means to say, ‘eat and drink and have a feast (rejoice) before me’ (without alluding to special pilgrims’ offerings)?—Ib. (ref. to Ex. XXIII, 18) ואי ס"ד דחגא הוא וכ' Ms. M. (ed. דחוגא) if you would say, חַגִּי means feast (merry-making) &c.—Koh. R. to III, 2 בין ח' וכ' between the Feast of Booths and Ḥănuckah. Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. חַגַּיָּא, חַגִּין</plural-form>. Targ. Ez. XLVI, 11; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>to turn</italic>,] (denom. of חַג)

<italic>locusts</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="H00217">

<senses>
<sense>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to commence anew, do again</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 7
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. (ref. to Num. XXVIII, 14) חַדֵּשׁ והבא וכ' commence a new account and offer T’rumah of the new produces.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to promulgate a new law, to establish a new interpretation of a Biblical law; to find a new point</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 104
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. (ref. to Lev. XXVI, 46) אין נביא רשאי לְחַדֵּשׁ וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) since the promulgation of

<italic>Halakhah</italic>); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<number>1)</number>

<italic>to be offered as a new point</italic> (דבר חדש).</definition>

<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. לא נשנית אלא בשביל דבר שנ' בה the section is repeated for the sake of a new point added.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to change turns</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 26
<sup>a</sup> משמרות מִתְחַדְּשׁוֹת the Temple attendants are relieved.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>the new produces of the field</italic> not permitted for use before the Omer day (Lev. XXIII, 10—14). Kidd. I, 9 (37
<sup>a</sup>) אף (מןּ) הח' also with the exception of the new produces (the law concerning which applies even to foreign countries). Ib. 39

<plural-form>Pl. חֲדָשִׁים</plural-form>. Yoma II, 4 ח' לקטורת בֹּאוּ new men for offering incense (such as never before have performed that function), come and &c. Ib. ח' גם ישנים new men and also old ones (who have officiated before this). Lev. R. s. 2, end (ref. to Cant. VII, 14) ח' the later leaders, opp. to ישנים the patriarchs; a. fr.—Fem. חֲדָשָׁה. Ib. s. 13 תורה ח' a new law, expl. חִדּוּשׁ תורה a novel interpretation of the law (concerning slaughtering). Pesik. Baḥod., p. 102
<sup>a</sup> פרוזדוגמא ח' a recent decree; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00231">
<head-word>חוּב</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.), perf.</definition>
<notes> חָב, part. חַיָיב, חָב [
<italic>to be bound over, seized</italic>,] </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be declared guilty, be sentenced; to be punishable; to be</italic> (
<italic>legally, morally or religiously</italic>) 
<italic>bound, to be responsible</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. I, 1 חב המזיק he who caused the damage must pay. Ib. 6
<sup>b</sup> חב … חייב … מיבעי לה the Mishnah says 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ab</italic>, ought it not rather to read 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ayab</italic> (part.)?—[Answ.: they are the words of a Jerusalem Tannai.]—Ib. I, 2 כל שׁחַבְתִּי בשמירתו וכ' for whatever I am legally bound to guard, I am legally answerable in case of injury. Sabb. I, 1 העני חייב the recipient (the person standing outside) is guilty (of transgressing the Sabbath law).—Y. Ned. I, 36
<sup>d</sup> top חב על כל וכ' he is punishable for each separately.—Ber. IX, 5 חייב אדם וכ' man must praise the Lord &c. Ḥag. 4
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. כל מצוה שהאשה חַיֶיבֶת בה וכ' whatever religious act is obligatory on woman, is also obligatory &c.—Ib. מה להלן נשים חַיָיבוֹת as there (Deut. XXXI, 12) women are included in the obligation; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to act in behalf of a person to the latter’s disadvantage</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. VII, 11 ואין חָבִין וכ', v. זָכָה. Y. B. Kam. IV, 4
<sup>b</sup> bot. בתחלה … ע"מ לָחוֹב להן וכ' originally guardians are not assigned to minors that they may eventually act to their disadvantage &c.; ואם חָבוּ חָבוּ but if they have done so, their action is legal (and they cannot be held responsible); Y. Gitt. V, 47
<sup>a</sup> top.—Y. Keth. XI, 34
<sup>b</sup> bot. נמצאתה חב וכ' then you would cause a disadvantage to the relics; a. fr.—ח' בעצמו 
<italic>to be alone answerable</italic> for one’s loss. Ber. I, 3 כדאי היית לָחוֹב בעצמך thou wouldst have deserved to be made answerable &c., i.e. if you had met with an accident you would have had none but yourself to blame.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to owe, be indebted</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. VII, 5; a. fr.—ח' חטאת 
<italic>to be bound to bring a sin-offering;</italic> ח' מיתה 
<italic>to be subject to death penalty</italic>. Sabb. VII, 1. Ib. XI, 6 כל חַיְיבֵי חטאת וכ' all those eventually bound to bring &c., are not bound, unless &c. Snh. 58
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִיֵּיב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to declare guilty, to convict, sentence</italic> (opp. זִיכָּה, פָּטַר).</definition>
<notes> Snh. 6
<sup>a</sup> ח' את הזכאי if a judge (by an illegal decision) convicted one who ought to have been acquitted. Ib. III, 6 ואחד מְחַיֵּיב and one votes for acquittal. Shebu. IV, 13 ר' מאיר מח' וכ' R. M. says, he is guilty (of blasphemy); a. v. fr.—Ex. R. s. 32, beg. חִיַּיבְתֶּם עצמיכם you have given judgment against yourselves. B. Mets. 3
<sup>b</sup> פיו אין מְחַיְּיבֹו ממון וכ' the defendant’s own statement cannot cause a judgment against him to pay a penalty, but causes the imposition of an oath. Yoma 35
<sup>b</sup> הלל מח' וכ', v. הִלֵּל.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְחוּיָּיב, מְחוּיָּב = חַיָיב, 
<italic>sentenced, bound</italic>. Y. Keth. III, 27
<sup>b</sup> מְחוּיְּיבֵי מיתות those sentenced to death, מ' מכות sentenced to lashes.—Ber. 20
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. כל שׁאינו מ' בדבר וכ' whatever is not obligatory upon a person himself, cannot be done by him as a representative of the community, v. חֹובָה; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחַיֵּיב, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְחַיֵּיב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be convicted, amenable to law</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 30
<sup>b</sup> מי שנ' סקילה he who (under Jewish jurisdiction) would have been sentenced to death through stoning. Ib. כבר נ' בגניבה וכ' he was amenable to punishment for theft, before he transgressed &c. Ib. מִתְחַיֵּיב בנפשו לא הוה וכ' but guilty of a deadly sin he was not until he ate it; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be responsible.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. III, 4, a. fr. הרי זה מתח' בנפשו he is responsible for his life, would have himself to blame, if any accident should befall him (v. Ber. 3 quoted above).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be doomed, to have the misfortune to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Shebu. III, 4 אין אדם מתח' לשמוע וכ' one has not the misfortune to hear (a curse &c.), unless he sinned himself (ref. to Lev. V, 1). Ib. הרואה … עבירה נ' לראות if one sees people sin, (we say) he had the misfortune to see, opp. זכה.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>to turn around, circle</italic>,] </definition>

<definition>
<italic>to dance</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. חָל, חוֹל; perf. חָל. Taan. IV, 8 יוצאות וחוֹלוֹת וכ' used to go out and dance in the vineyards; Lam. R. introd. וחָלוֹת (ר' זעירא) (ed. Wil. וחולות). Koh. R. to I, 11 חָלִין לפניו dance before Him, v. חוֹלָה. Gen. R. s. 74 חָלִים; Cant. R. to VII, 1; a. e.</notes></sense>

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (with על) 
<italic>to hover around one’s head, to rest upon one as a duty; to take effect</italic> (as a law).</definition>

<entry id="H00325">
<head-word>חוֹל, </head-word>
<hw-number>III</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> חלל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>outside of the sanctuary, foreign</italic>,] 
<italic>profane, common</italic>, opp. קוֹדֶשׁ; 
<italic>week-day</italic>, opp. שַׁבָּת, מוֹעֵד.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 104
<sup>a</sup>; Ḥull. 26
<sup>b</sup> בין קודש לח' between what is sacred and what is secular. Shebu. 35
<sup>b</sup> כל שמות … חוץ מזה שהוא ח' all names of lordship (
<italic>Adonay</italic>) … are sacred, except the following which is secular (referring to persons).—חוֹלוֹ של מועד, or חול המועד the half-festive days intervening between the first and the last days of Passover or of Succoth. Meg. 22
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Maas. Sh. III, 8 פתוחות לח' having an entrance on secular ground; ib. תוכן ח' their inside is secular ground. B. Mets. 84
<sup>b</sup> כלי … ישתמש בו ח' shall the vessel once used for sacred things, be used for secular purposes (shall R. Eleazar’s widow marry Rabbi)?; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. חוּלִּין</plural-form>
<italic>profane things, animals</italic> &c.
<italic> not consecrated, ordinary objects</italic>. Ḥull. 2
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. ח' שנעשו על וכ' ordinary food (not T’rumah) prepared with the precautions required for the levitical cleanness of consecrated food.—Pes. 22
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. ח' שנשחטו בעזרה animals not consecrated for sacrifices which were slaughtered in the Temple court. Ib., a. fr. ח' … דאורייתא the law forbidding the use of ordinary animals slaughtered &c., is not Biblical. Gitt. 62
<sup>a</sup> עיסת חוּלָּיו his ordinary dough; זיתי חוליו (not ים …), v. טָהֳרָה. Ḥag. I, 3 באות מן הח' are procured from secular funds, opp. to proceeds from second tithes; a. fr.—Ber. 32
<sup>a</sup> (play on ויחל, Ex. XXXII, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> ח' הוא לך וכ' it is too foreign to thy nature to do such a thing; Yalk. Gen. 83, v. 
<xref rid="H01048">חָלִילָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes>—
<italic>Ḥ</italic>
